title: Egyptian Oat Tagine
description: A hearty and nutritious North African-inspired tagine made with ground oats and a variety of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add diced tomatoes and water. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in ground oats and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
